marks.gloss_en: לא קשיא: הא דמצי לצעורי נפשיה, הא דלא מצי לצעורי נפשיה -- holy if he can bear the affliction; otherwise not
R' Elazar: a person should always regard himself as if the Holy one dwells within him, as it is said 'the Holy One is in your midst, and I will not come into the city' (Hos 11:9)
Reish Lakish: [one who fasts] is called pious, as it is said 'the man of kindness does good to his own soul, but he who troubles his flesh is cruel' (Prov 11:17)
Rav Yirmeya bar Abba: there is no public fast in Babylonia except the Ninth of Av alone
Rav Huna: if he slept in his fast [continued it through the night], he does not pray the fast prayer [the next morning]
Rav Yosef's first alternative: Rav Huna holds one does not fast for hours
one fasts for hours -- a fast of some hours counts as a fast
the jars of gentiles, after twelve months, are permitted
